CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION operations.prevent_audit_event_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
        ERRCODE = '55000',
        MESSAGE = 'P1_011_AUDIT_IMMUTABLE';
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pilot_ticket.ensure_intake_ticket_pair()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NEW.pilot_ticket_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM pilot_ticket.ticket AS ticket
         WHERE ticket.id = NEW.pilot_ticket_id
           AND ticket.source_intake_id = NEW.id
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING
            ERRCODE = '23514',
            MESSAGE = 'P1_005_INTAKE_TICKET_PAIR_MISMATCH';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pilot_ticket.ensure_ticket_intake_pair()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM intake.service_intake AS intake
         WHERE intake.id = NEW.source_intake_id
           AND intake.pilot_ticket_id = NEW.id
    ) OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM intake.service_intake AS intake
         WHERE intake.pilot_ticket_id = NEW.id
           AND intake.id <> NEW.source_intake_id
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING
            ERRCODE = '23514',
            MESSAGE = 'P1_005_TICKET_INTAKE_PAIR_MISMATCH';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.assert_time_contract()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'platform'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    forbidden_count integer;
    contract_count integer;
BEGIN
    SELECT count(*) INTO contract_count
      FROM platform.time_contract
     WHERE contract_version = 'ARCH-005/v1'
       AND business_timezone = 'Asia/Shanghai'
       AND precision = 'second';
    IF contract_count <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING
            ERRCODE = '55000',
            MESSAGE = 'ARCH_005_TIME_CONTRACT_MISSING';
    END IF;

    SELECT count(*) INTO forbidden_count
      FROM platform.forbidden_owned_schema_time_types();
    IF forbidden_count <> 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING
            ERRCODE = '55000',
            MESSAGE = 'ARCH_005_FORBIDDEN_TIME_TYPE_COUNT_NONZERO',
            DETAIL = format('count=%s', forbidden_count);
    END IF;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.forbidden_owned_schema_time_types()
 RETURNS TABLE(schema_name text, table_name text, column_name text, data_type text, udt_name text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'platform', 'information_schema'
AS $function$
    SELECT
        columns.table_schema::text,
        columns.table_name::text,
        columns.column_name::text,
        columns.data_type::text,
        columns.udt_name::text
      FROM information_schema.columns
     WHERE columns.table_schema = ANY (
               ARRAY[
                   'channel', 'intake', 'pilot_ticket', 'notification', 'operations',
                   'conversation', 'communication', 'platform', 'integration'
               ]::text[]
           )
       AND (
           columns.data_type IN ('timestamp with time zone', 'time with time zone')
           OR columns.udt_name IN ('timestamptz', 'timetz', 'tstzrange', 'tstzmultirange')
       )
     ORDER BY columns.table_schema, columns.table_name, columns.ordinal_position
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.local_from_epoch_ms(p_epoch_ms bigint)
 RETURNS timestamp without time zone
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'platform'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF p_epoch_ms < 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING
            ERRCODE = '22023',
            MESSAGE = 'ARCH_005_EPOCH_MS_INVALID';
    END IF;
    RETURN date_trunc(
        'second',
        to_timestamp(p_epoch_ms::double precision / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'
    )::timestamp without time zone;
EXCEPTION
    WHEN datetime_field_overflow THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING
            ERRCODE = '22008',
            MESSAGE = 'ARCH_005_EPOCH_MS_OUT_OF_RANGE';
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.local_now()
 RETURNS timestamp without time zone
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'platform'
AS $function$
    SELECT date_trunc('second', transaction_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::timestamp without time zone
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.physical_epoch_ms()
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'platform'
AS $function$
    SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) * 1000)::bigint
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION operations.prevent_audit_event_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
        ERRCODE = '55000',
        MESSAGE = 'P1_011_AUDIT_IMMUTABLE';
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pilot_ticket.ensure_intake_ticket_pair()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NEW.pilot_ticket_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM pilot_ticket.ticket AS ticket
         WHERE ticket.id = NEW.pilot_ticket_id
           AND ticket.source_intake_id = NEW.id
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING
            ERRCODE = '23514',
            MESSAGE = 'P1_005_INTAKE_TICKET_PAIR_MISMATCH';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pilot_ticket.ensure_ticket_intake_pair()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM intake.service_intake AS intake
         WHERE intake.id = NEW.source_intake_id
           AND intake.pilot_ticket_id = NEW.id
    ) OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM intake.service_intake AS intake
         WHERE intake.pilot_ticket_id = NEW.id
           AND intake.id <> NEW.source_intake_id
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING
            ERRCODE = '23514',
            MESSAGE = 'P1_005_TICKET_INTAKE_PAIR_MISMATCH';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.assert_time_contract()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'platform'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    forbidden_count integer;
    contract_count integer;
BEGIN
    SELECT count(*) INTO contract_count
      FROM platform.time_contract
     WHERE contract_version = 'ARCH-005/v1'
       AND business_timezone = 'Asia/Shanghai'
       AND precision = 'second';
    IF contract_count <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING
            ERRCODE = '55000',
            MESSAGE = 'ARCH_005_TIME_CONTRACT_MISSING';
    END IF;

    SELECT count(*) INTO forbidden_count
      FROM platform.forbidden_owned_schema_time_types();
    IF forbidden_count <> 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING
            ERRCODE = '55000',
            MESSAGE = 'ARCH_005_FORBIDDEN_TIME_TYPE_COUNT_NONZERO',
            DETAIL = format('count=%s', forbidden_count);
    END IF;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.forbidden_owned_schema_time_types()
 RETURNS TABLE(schema_name text, table_name text, column_name text, data_type text, udt_name text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'platform', 'information_schema'
AS $function$
    SELECT
        columns.table_schema::text,
        columns.table_name::text,
        columns.column_name::text,
        columns.data_type::text,
        columns.udt_name::text
      FROM information_schema.columns
     WHERE columns.table_schema = ANY (
               ARRAY[
                   'channel', 'intake', 'pilot_ticket', 'notification', 'operations',
                   'conversation', 'communication', 'platform', 'integration'
               ]::text[]
           )
       AND (
           columns.data_type IN ('timestamp with time zone', 'time with time zone')
           OR columns.udt_name IN ('timestamptz', 'timetz', 'tstzrange', 'tstzmultirange')
       )
     ORDER BY columns.table_schema, columns.table_name, columns.ordinal_position
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.local_from_epoch_ms(p_epoch_ms bigint)
 RETURNS timestamp without time zone
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'platform'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF p_epoch_ms < 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING
            ERRCODE = '22023',
            MESSAGE = 'ARCH_005_EPOCH_MS_INVALID';
    END IF;
    RETURN date_trunc(
        'second',
        to_timestamp(p_epoch_ms::double precision / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'
    )::timestamp without time zone;
EXCEPTION
    WHEN datetime_field_overflow THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING
            ERRCODE = '22008',
            MESSAGE = 'ARCH_005_EPOCH_MS_OUT_OF_RANGE';
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.local_now()
 RETURNS timestamp without time zone
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'platform'
AS $function$
    SELECT date_trunc('second', transaction_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::timestamp without time zone
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.physical_epoch_ms()
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'platform'
AS $function$
    SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) * 1000)::bigint
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION operations.prevent_audit_event_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
        ERRCODE = '55000',
        MESSAGE = 'P1_011_AUDIT_IMMUTABLE';
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pilot_ticket.ensure_intake_ticket_pair()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NEW.pilot_ticket_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM pilot_ticket.ticket AS ticket
         WHERE ticket.id = NEW.pilot_ticket_id
           AND ticket.source_intake_id = NEW.id
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING
            ERRCODE = '23514',
            MESSAGE = 'P1_005_INTAKE_TICKET_PAIR_MISMATCH';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pilot_ticket.ensure_ticket_intake_pair()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM intake.service_intake AS intake
         WHERE intake.id = NEW.source_intake_id
           AND intake.pilot_ticket_id = NEW.id
    ) OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM intake.service_intake AS intake
         WHERE intake.pilot_ticket_id = NEW.id
           AND intake.id <> NEW.source_intake_id
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING
            ERRCODE = '23514',
            MESSAGE = 'P1_005_TICKET_INTAKE_PAIR_MISMATCH';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.assert_time_contract()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'platform'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    forbidden_count integer;
    contract_count integer;
BEGIN
    SELECT count(*) INTO contract_count
      FROM platform.time_contract
     WHERE contract_version = 'ARCH-005/v1'
       AND business_timezone = 'Asia/Shanghai'
       AND precision = 'second';
    IF contract_count <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING
            ERRCODE = '55000',
            MESSAGE = 'ARCH_005_TIME_CONTRACT_MISSING';
    END IF;

    SELECT count(*) INTO forbidden_count
      FROM platform.forbidden_owned_schema_time_types();
    IF forbidden_count <> 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING
            ERRCODE = '55000',
            MESSAGE = 'ARCH_005_FORBIDDEN_TIME_TYPE_COUNT_NONZERO',
            DETAIL = format('count=%s', forbidden_count);
    END IF;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.forbidden_owned_schema_time_types()
 RETURNS TABLE(schema_name text, table_name text, column_name text, data_type text, udt_name text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'platform', 'information_schema'
AS $function$
    SELECT
        columns.table_schema::text,
        columns.table_name::text,
        columns.column_name::text,
        columns.data_type::text,
        columns.udt_name::text
      FROM information_schema.columns
     WHERE columns.table_schema = ANY (
               ARRAY[
                   'channel', 'intake', 'pilot_ticket', 'notification', 'operations',
                   'conversation', 'communication', 'platform', 'integration'
               ]::text[]
           )
       AND (
           columns.data_type IN ('timestamp with time zone', 'time with time zone')
           OR columns.udt_name IN ('timestamptz', 'timetz', 'tstzrange', 'tstzmultirange')
       )
     ORDER BY columns.table_schema, columns.table_name, columns.ordinal_position
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.local_from_epoch_ms(p_epoch_ms bigint)
 RETURNS timestamp without time zone
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'platform'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF p_epoch_ms < 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING
            ERRCODE = '22023',
            MESSAGE = 'ARCH_005_EPOCH_MS_INVALID';
    END IF;
    RETURN date_trunc(
        'second',
        to_timestamp(p_epoch_ms::double precision / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'
    )::timestamp without time zone;
EXCEPTION
    WHEN datetime_field_overflow THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING
            ERRCODE = '22008',
            MESSAGE = 'ARCH_005_EPOCH_MS_OUT_OF_RANGE';
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.local_now()
 RETURNS timestamp without time zone
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'platform'
AS $function$
    SELECT date_trunc('second', transaction_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::timestamp without time zone
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.physical_epoch_ms()
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'platform'
AS $function$
    SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) * 1000)::bigint
$function$
